metadata.description: Plugins that come with NewAl Code: one tap installs them, with nothing to download.

plugins.name: system
plugins.description: Your computer or phone, answered at once by a program (no model needed): /sysinfo (system, memory, storage, battery, the model sizes that fit), /disk (what takes the space), /clean (caches and old temporary files), /ports (what listens on which port), /programs (search, install, update with winget, pkg, Homebrew, apt).

plugins.name: guard
plugins.description: Safety with full access: asks before an edit to secrets (.env, keys) and before a force push, a hard reset, git clean, deleting a branch, dropping a database or publishing a package.

plugins.name: format-on-edit
plugins.description: After each edit, formats the file with its project's formatter: gofmt, rustfmt and dart always; ruff or black, prettier and clang-format where the project is set up for them. Nothing happens where none is installed.
